since.There is usually a connection with the present.For example,How long have you been working with we day?Meaning you are still working with we day.Also we day has been committing ourselves to supporting youth with resources to take meaningful action since then.So here this present perfect continues is used with since.And we day has been assembling a collection of powerful speeches in the hopes that they inspire you for years.So here present perfect continues is used with four years.The present perfect continues can be used to talk about actions repeated over a certain length of time.For example,We movement has been exploring various topics close to the hearts of youth, including cyberbullying, the environment, and mental health.And we movement events around the world have been sharing life experiences and campaigns for anti-racism, diversity, and inclusion.Some students may confuse the present perfect continues with the present perfect.These two tenses do have
